# TPC-Havoc Q11_v9

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH inventory_values AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    ps_partkey,
    SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) OVER (PARTITION BY ps_partkey) AS value
  FROM partsupp, supplier, nation
  WHERE
    ps_suppkey = s_suppkey AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_name = 'GERMANY'
), inventory_threshold AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0100000000 AS threshold
  FROM partsupp, supplier, nation
  WHERE
    ps_suppkey = s_suppkey AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_name = 'GERMANY'
)
SELECT
  ps_partkey,
  value
FROM inventory_values, inventory_threshold
WHERE
  value > threshold
ORDER BY
  value DESC
```
